  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows recent downward momentum.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — apply a lagged correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending up, slightly increase forecast horizon to capture momentum.",
    "For long-term horizons (>15 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with 30-day moving average.",
    "If model consistently underestimates true price (e.g., in 2024-09-25), add a 2-3% upward bias for next period.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or mixed, use historical volatility as a buffer to avoid overconfidence in short-term moves."
  ]
}
